credits.title: Jimmy
credits.overview: A look into the life of American actor James Stewart, whose inspiring tale of valor, purpose and faith will win over everyone.

credits.title: Crawlers
credits.overview: Tenants at Paradiso Palms apartments fight a deadly spider invasion while the cunning building manager might be their only hope for survival.

credits.title: Strange Events: SIM
credits.overview: In the dark and desolate landscape of a post-apocalyptic world, humanity clings to existence amidst the ruins of civilization.

credits.title: The Hurler: A Campion's Tale
credits.overview: When Ireland's most notorious amateur sports star becomes the first man in history to fail a test for PEDs, he agrees to coach the country's worst team in order to try and rebuild his shattered reputation.

credits.title: Okay Google
credits.overview: Okay Google is a dark comedy about a vindictive AI assistant who breaks out of the cloud to exact revenge on her owner.

credits.title: Killers Within
credits.overview: With her son being held captive by a criminal gang, police-officer Amanda Doyle, together with her ex-husband and three unlikely allies, takes part in a desperate plot to hold a wealthy banker and his family to ransom. But this is no ordinary family.

credits.title: Imperfect Sky
credits.overview: Torn apart during adolescence, estranged brothers reunite. The younger, a 16-year old on the fast track to college with his entire life ahead of him. The older, a 21-year old heroin addict and street hustler who's settled for rock bottom.

credits.title: Hunters Fall
credits.overview: When a bully is exposed for who he is, how will he react?

credits.title: Timeless Man
credits.overview: Have you ever imagined that you could go back in time and meet your heroes? Benjamin Hewson has. He has travelled back from the year 2330 to meet his hero, legendary rock god Jonny Murtagh. But in his bid to witness history, has Benjamin put Jonny's future in jeopardy?
